title: Lena and the Undertow
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Bram Zhou, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
